user.title: lumenctl
user.description: Uses the MQTT broker already configured in Home Assistant. In lumenctl, enable MQTT and turn off Home Assistant discovery.

data_description.base_topic: Topic prefix lumenctl publishes to. The default is lumenctl.
data_description.node_id: Leave empty to discover every computer. Set a node id to limit this entry to one PC.
